tokens.name: color-rail
tokens.usage: Deepest surface: an icon rail or the area behind the shell. Darker than canvas; nothing interactive sits directly on it.

tokens.name: color-canvas
tokens.usage: Page background, inputs (`.field`, search, checkbox) and the primary button's label. The ground every other surface steps up from.

tokens.name: color-shell
tokens.usage: The tray: the outer frame that holds status tabs around an inset panel; also resting filter chips.

tokens.name: color-panel
tokens.usage: Panels inside the tray, the table, sticky table headers, comment cards, the composer.

tokens.name: color-raised
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill, hover on nav rows and ghost buttons, count pills, Kbd keys.

tokens.name: color-selected
tokens.usage: Selected row, active nav item, highlighted menu option, the active tab's count pill. The top of the surface ladder.

tokens.name: color-overlay
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: menus, pickers, the date picker and dialogs, always with `shadow-float` and a `color-line-strong` border.

tokens.name: color-line
tokens.usage: Default 1px hairline: panel, field and pane-header borders, table row separators, the timeline spine. Below 3:1 on every surface by design; the source keeps separation quiet.

tokens.name: color-line-soft
tokens.usage: The faintest divider, between sections inside one panel.

tokens.name: color-line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders on floating layers, hovered fields and controls, unfilled progress segments, unselected checkbox outline.

tokens.name: color-fg
tokens.usage: Primary text and the primary button's fill. 13:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: color-fg-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: unselected nav and tab labels, table cells of closed requests, body of a next-step card. 6.6:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: color-fg-3
tokens.usage: Metadata: labels in property rows, timestamps, IDs, placeholders, counts. 4.7:1 on `color-selected`, more on lower surfaces.

tokens.name: color-fg-4
tokens.usage: Decoration only, never text (2.4–3.0:1): completed stepper marks, the unassigned avatar's dashed ring, hovered checkbox outline.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: focus ring (2px, 4.8:1 or better), selection markers, checked checkboxes, chart lines, unread state. Never the primary button.

tokens.name: color-accent-fg
tokens.usage: Accent as text: @mentions, unread counts on `accent` at 18% tint.

tokens.name: color-danger
tokens.usage: Reserved for blocked, urgent and overdue. Fills the urgent priority glyph; tints the danger button and blocked chip.

tokens.name: color-danger-fg
tokens.usage: Danger as text: blocked labels, inline errors, overdue dates, danger button label.

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Positive confirmation fills.

tokens.name: color-success-fg
tokens.usage: Success as text.

tokens.name: color-st-triage
tokens.usage: Status Triage: dashed ring glyph, chip tint. Always with its glyph and label.

tokens.name: color-st-todo
tokens.usage: Status To do: open ring glyph, chip tint.

tokens.name: color-st-progress
tokens.usage: Status In progress: half-filled glyph, chip tint.

tokens.name: color-st-review
tokens.usage: Status In review: three-quarter glyph, chip tint; the request-changes event icon.

tokens.name: color-st-done
tokens.usage: Status Done: filled check glyph, chip tint, the stepper's finished mark.

tokens.name: color-st-declined
tokens.usage: Status Declined: filled cross glyph, chip tint. 3.0–3.9:1, enough for a glyph, not for small text alone.

families.sans: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

styles.name: text-heading
styles.sample: Laptop for new starter, Aiko Tanaka
styles.usage: Request titles on the request page. Semibold is for titles only.

styles.name: text-title
styles.usage: Pane and page titles in the 48px header.

styles.name: text-read
styles.sample: Can we get a MacBook Air ordered before Monday? She starts in the London office.
styles.usage: Reading text: request descriptions and comments.

styles.name: text-ui
styles.usage: The base size: buttons, nav rows, table cells, menu options, inputs. Medium (500) for labels that act.

styles.name: text-meta
styles.usage: Metadata: property labels, timestamps, IDs, status chips, table headers. Tabular numerals for IDs, counts and dates.

styles.name: text-micro
styles.usage: Keyboard hints, Kbd keys, picker section titles, count badges.

spacing.note: Tailwind's 4px step. DESIGN.md names 4 / 8 / 12 / 16 / 20 / 24 / 32 as the scale; components also use 6px and 10px half-steps (gap-1.5, px-2.5).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tray inset (p-1), gap between tabs, menu list padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap in toolbars and button rows; nav row horizontal padding; property row gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between avatar and comment; button horizontal padding at md; footer padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Pane horizontal padding on mobile; dialog header and footer inset.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Pane horizontal padding on desktop; gap above a sidebar section label.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between facts in the inline details strip; empty-state side padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Largest step: separation between independent request sections.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, nav rows, filter chips, menu options.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Status chips, blocked chip, count pills.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Panels inside the tray, comment cards, the composer, next-step cards.

tokens.name: radius-tray
tokens.usage: The tray and dialogs.

shadow.note: Shadow only on floating layers (menus, dialogs). Everything else separates by 1px lines.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, pickers, the date picker and dialogs, on `color-overlay`.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: A sheet sliding over content from the right (the folded inspector on narrow screens).
